string.name: em_dob_invalid
string.value: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1990-04-12.

string.name: em_extra_help
string.value: Add anything a paramedic should know, for example Pacemaker: no.

string.name: em_card_privacy
string.value: Fields you switch off stay on this phone. They are left out of the card, the QR code and the first-responder view.

string.name: em_profile_intro
string.value: What a paramedic should know about you. Empty fields are not shown on the card.

string.name: em_row_sub
string.value: Blood type, allergies, doctor and more for the card

string.name: em_resp_open_sub
string.value: What not to give and what to use instead

string.name: em_resp_avoid_sub
string.value: Drugs with a known risk of torsades de pointes, and drugs to avoid in congenital long QT.

string.name: em_resp_instead_sub
string.value: Not on the QT-risk lists. Not listed doesn't guarantee safety; the treating doctor decides.

string.name: em_resp_source
string.value: Drug lists: CredibleMeds QTdrugs categories (crediblemeds.org), curated subset in the app. Care notes: ERC and ESC guidance. Not a medical device.

string.name: em_resp_offline
string.value: Works offline. Nothing on this page is sent anywhere.

string.name: em_nfc_hold
string.value: Hold an NFC tag to the back of the phone…

string.name: em_nfc_off
string.value: Turn on NFC in the phone settings first.

string.name: em_nfc_failed_start
string.value: NFC is not available right now.

string.name: em_nfc_written
string.value: Written. Any phone that taps this tag opens your card.

string.name: em_nfc_read_only
string.value: This tag is locked and can't be written.

string.name: em_nfc_io_failed
string.value: Couldn't write. Hold the tag still, or use a bigger tag (%s or larger).

string.name: em_nfc_not_ndef
string.value: This tag type isn't supported. Use an NTAG213, 215 or 216 sticker.

string.name: em_nfc_error
string.value: Couldn't write the tag. Try again.

string.name: em_nfc_too_long
string.value: This card link is too long for an NFC tag. Turn on sharing so the short link can be used.

string.name: em_nfc_hint
string.value: Needs a %s tag or larger. Write it again after you change your card. Not yet tested with a real tag.
